name: budget-opencode
description: Personal Finance Dashboard — Express + TypeScript + SQLite backend, React + Vite frontend. Local-only, no cloud.

scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend && wait
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.smoke: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix frontend run smoke
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
